questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Sometimes it can be a bit difficult with the choosing of courses etc., but it will work out
Also, the uni does not really provide any introductory/get-to-know-each-other activities, so it is a good idea to say yes to everything in the beginning and maybe go to the first one or two erasmus things in the beginning

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer:
Meeting new people and getting to be friends with people outside of Denmark 
Travelling Italy

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer:
Missing friends and family at home - but it is part of it 
Choosing courses
